purpose: Measured extraction plan for the unselected A/B dialogue and portrait UI source boards.

b.direction: practical salvager and military field interface

godotHandoff.dialogueFrame: Split into a fixed portrait-socket cap plus a NinePatchRect text-body segment after a choice is approved.
godotHandoff.turnQueuePortraitFrame: Use as a fixed-size TextureRect or AtlasTexture region; derive compact portrait masks from the selected branch.
godotHandoff.partyStatusPortraitFrame: Keep the portrait cap fixed and place runtime-owned bar fills over the empty rail slots.
godotHandoff.speakerNamePlate: Use as a NinePatchRect; typography remains a separate runtime Control node.
godotHandoff.rendering: Place UI on a CanvasLayer outside bloom, grading, blur, and scene post-processing.
godotHandoff.stateOwnership: Portraits, text, HP/status colors, queue states, focus, hover, selection, and disabled treatment remain runtime-owned.
